main.description: Broker-side checkout procedure. Creates a pending `network.attested.payment` record signed by the broker and returns a checkout URL plus a strongRef to the payment. Line item details are retained internally by the broker; they do not appear on the resulting record.

subject.description: DID of the payment recipient. Required by the broker so it knows whom to pay; the resulting `network.attested.payment` record only carries `subject` if the issuer opts in to publishing it.

items.description: Line items being paid for. Each entry is discriminated by `$type` as `#oneTime` or `#recurring`.

redirectUrl.description: URI the processor should redirect to after checkout completion or cancellation.

payment.description: StrongRef to the newly created `network.attested.payment` record.

checkoutUrl.description: Processor-hosted checkout URL the payer should be redirected to.

amount.description: Line total in the smallest unit of `currency` (PoS-side quantity is already multiplied in).

recurring.description: A recurring line item billed at a fixed interval.

amount.description: Per-period amount in the smallest unit of `currency`.

interval.description: Billing cadence. Discriminated by `$type`: `#namedInterval` for the common cases (weekly / monthly / yearly), `#customInterval` for a custom number of days.

namedInterval.description: One of the well-known billing cadences.

customInterval.description: An arbitrary number-of-days interval. Lets callers set non-standard cadences (every 14 days, every 90 days, etc.).

days.description: Length of one billing period in days.
